item.title: Kokusai-dori Guide: Shopping, Eats & Access (Naha)
item.description: Kokusai-dori (“International Street”) is Naha’s bustling main thoroughfare — a roughly 1.6 km stretch lined with souvenir shops, restaurants, izakaya, cafés and street performers. Rebuilt in the years after WWII and nicknamed the “Miracle Mile,” it’s the liveliest place in Okinawa to shop for local crafts and snacks, sample Okinawan cuisine, and feel the island’s easygoing energy. Dip into the covered market arcades just off the main drag for a more local, atmospheric experience.
